jobs.title: Commercial Cabinet Installer
jobs.summary: Install commercial casework and countertops on schools, healthcare, restaurant and office projects across North Texas.
duties: Set, level, scribe and fasten cabinets to shop drawings
Work punch lists and walk finished work with the general contractor
Keep job sites clean, safe and on schedule
requirements: Experience installing cabinets or finish carpentry
Own hand tools and reliable transportation
Able to read shop drawings and lift 75 lbs

jobs.title: Cabinet Assembler
jobs.summary: Build commercial cabinet boxes, drawers and doors from CNC-cut parts in our North Richland Hills shop.
duties: Assemble cabinets to shop drawings and cut lists
Scan parts and log progress at your station
Check work for square, fit and finish
requirements: Cabinet or millwork shop experience preferred
Comfortable with pneumatic and power tools
Attention to detail and accurate measuring
Able to stand and lift through a full shift

jobs.title: CNC & Machine Operator
jobs.summary: Run our CNC router and edgebander, keeping parts moving accurately to assembly.
duties: Load programs and sheet goods and run the CNC
Label parts and sort them for assembly
Run the edgebander and keep machines maintained
Verify part sizes against cut lists
requirements: CNC router or panel-processing experience preferred
Mechanical aptitude and a careful, safe approach
Willing to be trained on our equipment

jobs.title: Production Helper
jobs.summary: Entry-level role supporting every station in the shop. No experience required, and a clear path into assembly, machining or installation.
duties: Stage materials and move parts between stations
Help with assembly, edgebanding and packing
Keep the shop clean and organized
requirements: Reliable, on time and ready to learn
Able to lift 50 lbs and stand for a full shift
